title: Placement Tier Classification & CTC Thresholds
rule_text: Placement offers are classified into three tiers by the top of the CTC band: Standard is any offer below 8.0 LPA, Dream is 8.0 to 14.99 LPA, and Super-Dream is 15.0 LPA and above. Tier classification determines nomination gates, offer caps, and upward mobility rules.

title: One-Offer-Per-Tier & Upward Mobility Policy
rule_text: A student may hold at most one offer per placement tier. A student who has accepted a Standard offer may only apply upward to Dream or Super-Dream roles, never laterally or downward. An offer acceptance is binding once confirmed and must be locked within 48 hours of the offer release.

title: Minimum CGPA & Active Backlog Cutoffs
rule_text: Recruiter GPA cutoffs are strict and non-waivable at the drive level. A student must have zero active backlogs to be eligible for Super-Dream roles, at most one active backlog for Dream roles, and departmental clearance for Standard roles. Students below the recruiter's stated CGPA cutoff are not nominated.

title: Mandatory AI Mock-Interview Gate for Dream & Super-Dream Roles
rule_text: Students seeking nomination for Dream (8-15 LPA) or Super-Dream (>=15 LPA) placement drives must complete at least one technical AI mock interview on the platform and secure a verified score of 65/100 or higher. Students scoring below 65 are blocked from recruiter shortlists until a successful re-interview is completed.

title: Skill Readiness & Course Pre-requisite Policy
rule_text: A student below 40% required-skill coverage for a role, or in the early readiness band, is blocked from nomination until the assigned upskilling course items for the missing required skills are completed. Completing assigned courses raises the readiness band and re-enables nomination.

title: No-Show Penalty & Placement Suspension
rule_text: An unexcused absence from a registered interview or assessment results in a 14-day suspension from all placement drives. A second no-show infraction in the same placement season forfeits placement eligibility for that season.

title: PPO Conversion & Dual-Option Rules
rule_text: A Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) obtained from an internship must be reported to the TPO within 7 calendar days of receipt. A converted PPO counts as an offer in the tier corresponding to its CTC and is subject to the one-offer-per-tier cap.

title: Resume Grounding & Zero-Fabrication Policy
rule_text: Every claim on a student resume must be backed by verifiable coursework, certificates, or public repository commits. Fabrication, exaggeration, or misattribution of projects or skills results in immediate debarment from placement by the TPO.

title: Inter-Disciplinary & Cross-Branch Eligibility
rule_text: Non-CSE students are eligible for technology drives if they have completed certified bridge courses or demonstrate at least 70% required-skill match, unless the recruiter imposes a strict branch mandate. Branch restrictions, when present, are enforced at the drive level.

title: Attendance & Semester NOC Protocols
rule_text: A minimum of 75% aggregate semester attendance is mandatory to receive the TPO No Objection Certificate (NOC) required for on-campus and off-campus placement participation.

title: Placement Drive Registration & Withdrawal Deadlines
rule_text: Drive registration closes 48 hours before the drive begins. Withdrawal without penalty is allowed up to 24 hours before the drive; a later withdrawal or a failure to appear after registration is recorded as a no-show under SOP-06.

title: Off-Campus Offer Reporting & NOC Protocols
rule_text: Off-campus drives require prior notification to the TPO. Offer letters for off-campus roles must be deposited with the TPO within 5 business days to receive academic credit and tier classification.

title: Multiple Same-Day Offer Resolution Priority
rule_text: If a student receives multiple offers on the same calendar day, the student must declare a priority choice within 24 hours. The declared priority is final and resolves the placement conflict.

title: 8th Semester Internship-to-Placement Transition
rule_text: A full-semester internship in the 8th semester requires a minimum 7.0 CGPA and Dean approval for remote capstone work and credit transfer toward placement equivalence.

title: Corporate Interview Etiquette & NDA Compliance
rule_text: Students must wear formal attire, arrive punctually, and refrain from using external tools, AI assistants, or unauthorized resources during assessments. Strict NDA compliance is required; violating an NDA results in offer revocation.

title: Medical & Compassionate Absence Deferrals
rule_text: A documented medical emergency certified by the university health center, or a compassionate circumstance, exempts a student from the SOP-06 no-show penalty provided it is reported to the TPO within 48 hours of the incident.

title: Placement Grievance Redressal & Appeal SLA
rule_text: Disciplinary or eligibility disputes may be appealed to the TPO Grievance Committee within 72 hours of the decision. The committee issues a binding decision within 5 business days of the appeal filing.

title: Equal Opportunity & Reasonable Accommodation
rule_text: Documented disabilities or special needs receive customized assessment timing, extended time, and assistive platform support during placement evaluations to ensure equal opportunity.
